page_title: BOC 1-1 LEV | Bochum v Bayer Leverkusen 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Here comes a substitution. Tim Oermann is given a rest as he is replaced by Ivan Ordets (Bochum).
90+2' Robert Hartmann sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+1' Wait! Referee Robert Hartmann has indicated he is going to review the Bochum goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' 1 - 1 Goal! Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:1.
89' Lukas Hradecky comes off his line to intercept the corner from Koji Miyoshi (Bochum).
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jeremie Frimpong walks off the pitch to be replaced by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
84' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
84' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
79' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Dieter Hecking has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani de Wit (Bochum) replacing Felix Passlack.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch so that Patrik Schick can be given a rest.
77' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets a yellow card. The referee Robert Hartmann made the right call.
77' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
75' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
74' Felix Passlack (Bochum) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
72' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
71' Robert Hartmann blows for a foul after Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
70' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
69' The substitution is prepared. Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Moritz Broschinski.
69' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Gerrit Holtmann is replaced by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Anthony Losilla as he is replaced by Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
67' Felix Passlack (Bochum) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
66' Matus Bero (Bochum) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

65' PENALTY APPEAL after Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jonas Hofmann will be replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
63' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
61' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
61' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' 2:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
55' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
53' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.

52' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Patrick Drewes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
48' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Matus Bero (Bochum) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
40' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
40' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
38' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) launches a cross from the corner, but Lukas Hradecky is alert to thwart the effort.
36' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
35' 6:4 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
34' Robert Hartmann couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) and blew his whistle.
33' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Patrick Drewes intercepts the ball.
31' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

30' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Patrick Drewes shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
27' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Hartmann saw the whole situation.
26' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
25' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
23' The possession of the ball – 26:74.
20' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bochum was in an offside position.
18' 0 - 1 Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) has a golden opportunity after receiving a beautiful pass. He keeps his cool and takes a low shot which ricochets in off the right post.
16' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Referee Robert Hartmann sees the trip by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
13' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
10' Felix Passlack (Bochum) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
9' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
8' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
6' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen).
3' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Hartmann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
Robert Hartmann got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
